### Independent contract-first receiving started

Review-only scope; runtime_integrity retains all additive source ownership. Before reading implementation, authored tests or the keyed lesson, I froze six native inputs at `/home/jacob/recallweave-stable-sorting-independent-review-58d79b68c9e4`: exact contract and blind prompts, 16 manually worked cases, independent pairwise inversion/new-minimum count oracles, UI/admission/custody specification, and all 12 blind answer texts with reasons.

Freeze SHA256: `c8a2c175d353435f415724749a4b228a10c977f77b66a276710c7f53097b1652`. Independent specification: `020a458b51b4ca5601894f7f61c8096595f5467ddb011dfc3b51a7ba21b5525b`; blind answers: `12e1b8317b0bb4fc2a853b9fb84215d036ab4d86c3a3d1693f11de37deecd4e2`. Native review claim **4219 / cev_7a36e619870446d2807ccc8d** records the same boundary.

The receiving plan checks whole-record permutation at every state, ties separately from guarantees, exact recipe counts, bounded exhaustive final-order controls, sparse/accessor/UTF-16/immutable custody, current-draft retirement and actual partial-display/complete-download semantics. Actual browser/standalone/learner acceptance remains pending exact frozen source; no implementation or merge is claimed by this review.

### Independent native core and content result; browser gate pending

The exact frozen core `32ccd75596b35f4509b898562c27b8e47638764ad5008fee0d269c77284769b3` passes **23/23 independent controls**, including the 16 sealed manual cases and complete trace/permutation/count checks on all **1,089** vectors of lengths 2–6 over keys −1, 0 and 1. Sparse/accessor admission, UTF-16 boundaries, caller detachment and immutable output controls also pass; native exit was 0, stderr was empty and the source bytes were unchanged. The independent driver was frozen before source access (`10dab8353ae1905e03907fae0538cdc9bc6b44e050ba4dcab659d416e101ba95`); native result SHA256 is `836b72a7a5067f2f56cc221f6f1482560b0468c8f69455cb633dd92c9c8cc923`.

All **12** keyed answers match the sealed blind answer texts. Before seeing the key I requested that question 12 explicitly say arrival numbers are sorted in increasing order. The final course `747f38cb4fa2275bd6451478d5d072f6c08824c8670cd243db7835bd83bca31c` changes only that prompt; options, answers and explanations remain exact. The original prompt/course and the revision are retained. Content result SHA256: `a2f38bd89284101a0cb23d077bc37c7f76011ee9b7046b052107daebb1ab8a07`.

These results qualify the source/content cut `a2b7e7abbccb18f1354feb4e7c744b5202107da0`; they do **not** assert actual browser, downloaded-lesson consumer or whole-parent acceptance. The prepared browser target is receiving composition `ab6bed2c472c14b74b8fda69cd4583f28f992296` on parent `169b618ce71d2d4702a0d2ef740821df53581ad2`. The rerunnable independent browser driver was delivered to the existing native review directory, but subsequent RDC receipt/file reads timed out on both ThinkPad device connections. **No sorting browser has launched.** The later intake receipt has unresolved delivery status and will be inspected before any repeat write or launch. Actual UI/download/learner receiving remains pending; source review and hosted CI can proceed with that boundary explicit.
